An AI assistant that answers from your store, not from guesswork

Selo’s AI reads your customers’ WhatsApp messages and replies using your live Shopify orders, products, policies and FAQs. When it can’t or shouldn’t answer, it hands the chat to your team.

Install on ShopifyBook a demo

Three modes, your choice

Off

Your team answers everything in the Selo inbox.

Suggest

The AI drafts each reply; your team sends, edits or discards it.

Auto-reply

The AI sends replies to routine questions such as order status, delivery and store info. You can limit auto-replies to outside your business hours.

What it can answer

  • Where is my order, and tracking
  • What’s in stock, prices and sizes
  • Refund, shipping and other store policies
  • Your own FAQs and notes

Order in the chat

The customer names a product. The AI checks the exact variant, stock and price, then sends a summary with Confirm and Cancel buttons. Confirm sends a checkout link with the cart filled in.

  • Nothing is ordered until the customer pays.
  • Prices and totals always come from Shopify, never from the AI.

Understands photos

  • A photo of a damaged item opens a return case for your team.
  • “Do you have this?” with a photo finds similar products.
  • Payment screenshots go to your team.

Knows when to hand over

Complaints, refund and change requests, angry customers, requests for a person, or anything it isn’t sure about go to your team. The customer is told a person will reply.

Guardrails built in

  • Order numbers, amounts, tracking codes and links in a reply must come from your store’s data, or the reply isn’t sent.
  • It only replies inside WhatsApp’s 24-hour customer service window.
  • It never asks for payment details or passwords.
  • It never offers discounts or changes orders on its own.
  • Customers who reply STOP are opted out and get no AI reply.

Speaks your customers’ language

Choose reply languages and tone (friendly, professional or casual). It replies in the customer’s language, mixes like Hinglish included, when that’s one of your languages.

Your knowledge base

Shopify policies are imported automatically and kept fresh. Add FAQs and notes in plain words.

You control the cost

Every plan includes a monthly AI budget. You choose what happens when it’s used up: keep suggestions only, or turn the AI off.
